environment: Isolated fictional demonstration database, mock mode

observations.text: what is the purpose of this app

mello gives you a simple place to practice a one-minute breathing exercise. Follow four counts in and six counts out, choose a moving circle or text, and pause or stop whenever you want. I can help you find features, explain the practice, and explore the reading shelf.
I’m mello’s app assistant, not a therapist. I can explain the practice and reviewed information, but I can’t diagnose, provide treatment, or monitor anyone.
